bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,ast
p=Path("scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py")
src=p.read_text()
needle='ACTIONS = frozenset({'
anchor='    if action == "room_private_smoke":'
if src.count(needle)!=1 or src.count(anchor)!=1:raise SystemExit(61)
if 'if action == "read_gay_posting_panel":' in src:raise SystemExit(62)
block='''    if action == "read_gay_posting_panel":
        if set(request) != {"request_id", "action", "message_id"}:
            raise ValueError("REQUEST_SHAPE_INVALID")
        mid = request["message_id"]
        if not isinstance(mid, int) or mid <= 0 or mid > 100000000:
            raise ValueError("MESSAGE_ID_INVALID")
        bot_user = await client.get_entity("GayBBS_bot")
        panel = await client.get_messages(-1003770334893, ids=mid)
        if not panel:
            return {"request_id": request_id, "action": action, "status": "FAIL", "error": "PANEL_NOT_FOUND"}
        rows = [[b.text for b in row] for row in (panel.buttons or [])]
        return {"request_id": request_id, "action": action, "status": "PASS",
                "bot_authored": panel.sender_id == bot_user.id,
                "has_bug_report": bool(rows and rows[-1] == ["🐞 不具合を報告"]),
                "row_sizes": [len(r) for r in rows]}
'''
new=src.replace(needle,needle+'"read_gay_posting_panel", ',1).replace(anchor,block+anchor,1)
ast.parse(new)
backup=Path.home()/".local/state/tgtumbler/bugreport-ipc-panel-read-20261115"
backup.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if backup.exists():raise SystemExit(63)
backup.write_text(src)
os.chmod(backup,0o600)
tmp=p.with_name(".userbot_resident_ipc.panel-read.tmp")
with tmp.open("x") as f:f.write(new)
os.chmod(tmp,p.stat().st_mode&0o777)
os.replace(tmp,p)
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 64
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 65
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 66
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from userbot_test_client import invoke
r=asyncio.run(invoke("health"))
assert r.get("status")=="PASS" and r.get("authorized") is True
print("USERBOT_PANEL_READ_READY=PASS")
PY
